findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The English names the extension package **shinyWidgets**; the Portuguese names it **BrightWidgets**, a package that does not exist.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader searching CRAN or GitHub for BrightWidgets finds nothing and cannot install the package, even though the same bullet still calls shinyWidgets::shinyWidgetsGallery().

findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The English names the extension package **shinyjs**; the Portuguese names it **Brightjs**, a package that does not exist.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader cannot find or install shinyjs, so the recommended route to hide/show elements and enable/disable buttons is unreachable.

findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The English names the extension package **shinydashboard**; the Portuguese names it **Brightdashboard**, a package that does not exist.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader cannot install the package that the chapter's own 'Building a UI' section already referred to as shinydashboard, and the two mentions no longer agree.

findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The English names the extension package **shinydashboardPlus**; the Portuguese names it **BrightdashboardPlus**, a package that does not exist.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader cannot install the package; the link target still says shinydashboardPlus, so the reader gets contradictory names for one package.

findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The English names the extension package **shinythemes**; the Portuguese names it **Brightthemes**, a package that does not exist.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader cannot install shinythemes and so cannot apply the preset CSS themes the section recommends.

findings.heading: Adding a facility selector / Adicionando um seletor de instalação
findings.proposition: The prose states that the variables just created in global.R are passed straight to the UI, but the Portuguese code names that variable installation_list at its only definition site (line 976) while every use site, including the UI chunk beside this prose (line 1033), still reads facility_list.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader who copies the code gets 'object facility_list not found' when the app starts, and the prose gives no hint that the two names must be reconciled.

findings.heading: Adding a facility selector / Adicionando um seletor de instalação
findings.proposition: The prose tells the reader to add 'this code chunk' to global.R, but the Portuguese chunk carries echo = FALSE so the code that builds all_districts and the facility table is never displayed.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader is told to copy a chunk that the rendered page does not show, so cannot build all_districts or the facility lookup table and cannot follow the rest of the section.

findings.heading: Adding a facility selector / Adicionando um seletor de instalação
findings.proposition: The prose says 'let us test it' and the English chunk shows the test call plot_epicurve(malaria_data, district = "Spring", agegroup = "malaria_rdt_0-4", facility = "Facility 1"), but the Portuguese chunk carries echo=F so no call is shown.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader sees only the resulting figure and never sees how the new facility argument is supplied, so cannot reproduce the test of the updated function.

findings.heading: Recommended extension packages / Pacotes de extensão recomendados
findings.proposition: The Portuguese adds a parenthetical gloss stating that 'shiny' is a pun meaning 'brilhante' (bright) in English; the English has no such gloss.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader is led to treat the package family name as a wordplay, which sets up the renamed Bright* package names in the bullets that follow and reinforces the false names.

findings.heading: Dashboards with Shiny / Painéis com Shiny
findings.proposition: The English says the alternative METHOD is faster, easier and perhaps less customisable; the Portuguese says the method makes the DASHBOARDS faster, easier and perhaps less customisable.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader concludes that R Markdown dashboards run faster at the cost of customisation, rather than that the authoring route is quicker to learn and use, and may pick the tool for a performance reason that does not exist.
